alternaria_leaf_spot.label: Alternaria Leaf Spot
alternaria_leaf_spot.summary: A fungal disease causing dark, target-like spots on leaves.
alternaria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Brown-to-black concentric rings, often with a yellow halo. Spots enlarge and merge.
alternaria_leaf_spot.action: Remove affected leaves. Apply a copper-based or chlorothalonil fungicide. Improve airflow between plants.

bacterial_leaf_spot.label: Bacterial Leaf Spot
bacterial_leaf_spot.summary: A bacterial infection producing water-soaked lesions.
bacterial_leaf_spot.symptoms: Small dark spots that turn angular and necrotic; often a yellow halo.
bacterial_leaf_spot.action: Remove infected leaves. Avoid overhead watering. Apply copper-based bactericide. Rotate crops next season.

black_rot.label: Black Rot
black_rot.summary: A serious bacterial disease that can destroy a crop.
black_rot.symptoms: Yellow V-shaped lesions at leaf edges, blackened veins, wilting.
black_rot.action: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately. Do not compost. Practice 2–3 year crop rotation. Use certified disease-free seed.

clubroot.label: Clubroot
clubroot.summary: A soil-borne disease affecting the roots.
clubroot.symptoms: Stunted growth, wilting in heat, swollen distorted roots.
clubroot.action: Remove infected plants including roots. Lime soil to raise pH to 7+. Do not replant brassicas in the same bed for 3–5 years.

downy_mildew.label: Downy Mildew
downy_mildew.summary: A fungal-like disease favored by cool, damp conditions.
downy_mildew.symptoms: Pale-yellow patches on the upper leaf surface, grey-white fuzzy growth underneath.
downy_mildew.action: Improve ventilation. Remove affected leaves. Apply a downy-mildew-specific fungicide. Avoid evening watering.

grey_mould.label: Grey Mould
grey_mould.summary: A fungal disease that thrives in humid, crowded conditions.
grey_mould.symptoms: Fuzzy grey-brown growth on damaged or dying tissue.
grey_mould.action: Remove affected plant parts. Increase spacing and airflow. Avoid excess nitrogen. Apply a suitable fungicide if severe.

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.symptoms: Leaves are firm, uniformly colored, with no lesions or discoloration.
healthy.action: Continue current care. Monitor regularly for early signs.

ringspot.label: Ringspot
ringspot.summary: A viral or fungal disease producing ring-shaped lesions.
ringspot.symptoms: Circular rings or concentric patterns on leaves; may distort growth.
ringspot.action: Remove affected leaves. Control aphids and other vectors. Remove severely affected plants. Do not save seed from infected plants.

unknown.label: Unable to Diagnose
unknown.summary: The image did not match a known cabbage disease with sufficient confidence.
unknown.action: Retake the photo in good light, filling the frame with a single leaf. Avoid blur and shadows.
